subject: Tri‑Band deep‑dive rotation — proposing open windows and next steps
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Sam Woods <sam.woods@veridianhealth.com>, Priya Patel <p.pr@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Jun 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Tri‑Band deep‑dive rotation — proposing open windows and next steps

Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call today. Quick recap and two asks to lock in the next step (45m technical deep‑dive):

Recap (very short):
- Primary goals: benchmark inference latency on your 2–3 core flows, validate KV‑cache behavior on long sessions, discuss routing/fallback for EU traffic.
- Constraints: Compliance review on SOC2 evidence next week; primary devs in US (PT) and EU (CET) with one director in APAC (SGT) available mornings.

Proposal (scheduling):
Because the team is distributed, we recommend a rotating tri‑band window so the same stakeholders can attend over a 6‑week pilot without always meeting at the same local time. Suggested rotation model:

Option A — Weekly rotation (recommended):
- Week 1: US block — 11:00–11:45 PT (14:00–14:45 ET / 20:00–20:45 CET)
- Week 2: EU block — 09:00–09:45 CET (00:00–00:45 PT)
- Week 3: APAC block — 10:00–10:45 SGT (19:00–19:45 PT previous day)

Option B — Tri‑week compressed (every third week repeats the band) — fewer calendar moves for each attendee.

Option C — Fixed alternating lanes (US/EU on alternate weeks, APAC on ad‑hoc days).

Ask 1 — Pick preferred model (A/B/C) or tell us constraints.
Ask 2 — Which timezone windows are absolute hard stops for you or your execs? (e.g., Priya said mornings CET are best; flag any recurring all‑hands).

Practicals:
- We'll run a 45m session (30m demo + 15m Q&A) and include a short triage doc afterwards.
- Ben Carter (solutions) and Priyom Das (infra) will join from our side.
- I attached a one‑pager (redwood-demo-pack.pdf) and a provisional availability ICS (concurrent-availability.ics) to drop into shared calendars.

If helpful, here's a one‑click calendar option — https://calendly.com/redwood/tech-deep-dive — but happy to coordinate manually if you have procurement calendar rules.

Thanks — looking to lock the first session next week so we can run the pilot in July.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

+1 (415) 555‑0192

Subject: Re: Tri‑Band deep‑dive rotation — proposing open windows and next steps

Thanks Irene — good summary.

A couple quick notes on constraints from our side:
- We prefer a rotation rather than fixed lanes (so Option A looks best).
- We have recurring customer calls 09:00–10:00 PT (which is why 11:00 PT is tight for the lead engineer on some weeks). Can you shift the US block 1 hour later (12:00–12:45 PT) on US weeks? That keeps it within our afternoon for EU and still tolerable for APAC on rotation weeks.

Also, we'll need the security QA checklist before the first session so our compliance team can triage SOC2 items. If possible, attach a short version of the security artifacts (only the checklist) rather than the full binder.

Happy to confirm as soon as you send a proposed first date/time.

—Sam
